voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Kung dadaan ka sa Balete Drive pagkalipas ng hatinggabi, huwag kang titingin sa salamin.
lines.beat_before: hook: the rear-view mirror, an empty back seat, the rosary swinging

lines.text: Ipinangalan ang kalyeng ito sa isang puno ng balete na dating nakatayo sa gitna ng daan.
lines.beat_before: from the back seat: the driver, the windshield, Balete Drive at night

lines.text: Mula pa noong dekada singkwenta, iisa ang kuwento ng mga driver.
lines.beat_before: headlights find the balete: aerial roots wider than the road

lines.text: Isang babaeng nakaputi, sa tabi ng puno, pumapara.
lines.beat_before: a woman in white at its foot, hand raised, face hidden by hair
the taxi does not stop; side window: she is beside the glass

lines.text: Hindi na mahalaga. Pagtingin nila sa salamin,
lines.beat_before: the meter starts by itself; the rosary stops swinging, pulled back
mirror empty; a glance at the road; mirror again: hair over the headrest

lines.text: Sabi ng iba, dito siya namatay. Sabi ng iba, nandito na siya mula pa noong giyera. Walang nakaalam kung sino talaga siya.
lines.beat_before: held silence; push into the mirror; half a face lit by the dash; stinger; the driver turns: empty seat, wet ring, sampaguita

lines.text: Wala na ang puno. Bago na ang mga bahay.
lines.beat_before: high over Balete Drive: new houses and condos, one taxi

lines.text: Pero hanggang ngayon, umiikot pa rin ang mga driver.
lines.beat_before: through the windshield: the balete again ahead, the woman under it
